policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.intro: Heritage Bites respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) of South Africa.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you place an order, submit an enquiry, make a reservation, or contact us, we may collect your name and surname, contact number, email address, delivery or collection address, and payment-related information processed through secure third-party providers.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body: We use this information to process and fulfil orders, provide customer support, manage reservations and catering requests, improve our products and services, and communicate important updates regarding your order.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Your information may be shared only with trusted service providers involved in processing payments, delivering orders, or providing website services.

sections.heading: Address suggestions
sections.body: When you type a delivery address at checkout, the text you have typed so far is sent to the OpenStreetMap address service (photon.komoot.io) to suggest matching addresses. Only that address text is sent — never your name, phone number, email address or payment details — and we do not store the suggestions. You can ignore the suggestions and type your address in full; nothing else changes.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, subject to legal requirements. Contact us on +27 67 013 7587 or heritagebitesfood@gmail.com to make a request.

policies.title: Website Terms of Use
policies.intro: By using the Heritage Bites website, placing an order, or booking our services, you agree to these terms and conditions.

sections.heading: Accurate information
sections.body: Customers must provide accurate information when placing orders, and are responsible for ensuring delivery or collection details are correct.

sections.heading: Menu and imagery
sections.body: Product images are for illustration purposes and actual presentation may vary. Menu items, pricing, and availability may change without notice.

sections.heading: Refusing or cancelling an order
sections.body: Heritage Bites reserves the right to refuse or cancel an order if incorrect pricing, stock shortages, technical errors, or suspected fraud are identified.

sections.heading: Delays
sections.body: Heritage Bites is not liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including traffic, weather conditions, power outages, or third-party delivery service interruptions.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: All intellectual property on the website, including logos, branding, content, and images, remains the property of Heritage Bites.

policies.title: Delivery
policies.intro: Heritage Bites is a delivery-only kitchen serving Thursdays and Fridays between 12:00 and 13:30.

sections.heading: Service days and times
sections.body: We cook and deliver on Thursdays and Fridays only. Delivery and collection both run between 12:00 and 13:30. Orders placed outside those times are recorded as pre-orders for the next service day.

sections.heading: Delivery areas
sections.body: We deliver everywhere within 50 km of our kitchen in Sandton. Delivery is included in the plate price in Sandton and Rosebank; anywhere further out up to 50 km carries a delivery fee, confirmed on WhatsApp before you pay. Beyond 50 km we do not deliver, and the checkout will tell you so before you order.

sections.heading: Minimum order and delivery fee
sections.body: The minimum order is R100 for plated meals. Inside Sandton and Rosebank there is no separate delivery fee — the run is included in the plate price, so you pay R100 for a traditional plate and R130 for a contemporary one. Outside those areas a delivery fee applies; the exact amount is confirmed on WhatsApp before payment.

sections.heading: No collection
sections.body: We are a delivery-only kitchen. There is no counter to collect from and no collection point; every order is brought to the address you gave at checkout, within the service window.

sections.heading: Preparation and delivery estimates
sections.body: Plated meals are prepared to order and typically need about 20 minutes. Delivery in Rosebank and Sandton usually takes about 30 minutes from dispatch, within the 12:00 to 13:30 service window.

policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.intro: We strive to provide high-quality food and service. If you experience an issue with your order, please contact us as soon as possible.

sections.heading: When refunds may be considered
sections.body: An incorrect order was supplied; food was not delivered; or a food quality issue is reported promptly and supported by reasonable evidence where requested.

sections.heading: When refunds are generally not available
sections.body: A change of mind after an order has been prepared; delays caused by circumstances outside our reasonable control; or incorrect delivery information provided by the customer.

sections.heading: How refunds are paid
sections.body: Approved refunds will be processed using the original payment method where possible.

policies.title: Order Cancellation Policy
policies.intro: Cancellation depends on how far an order has progressed. Contact us on +27 67 013 7587 or WhatsApp as soon as possible.

sections.heading: Standard orders
sections.body: Orders may be cancelled without charge if preparation has not yet commenced. Once an order has entered preparation, Heritage Bites may charge for costs already incurred and may refuse cancellation.

sections.heading: Catering and event orders
sections.body: Cancellations made more than 7 days before the event may qualify for a full refund, less any non-refundable costs already incurred. Cancellations made within 7 days of the event may be subject to partial or full cancellation charges depending on preparation and procurement commitments.

sections.heading: Assessment
sections.body: Heritage Bites reserves the right to assess cancellations on a case-by-case basis.

settings.outsideFeeNote: Farther than the included run we add a small delivery fee, confirmed on WhatsApp before you pay.
